errors.evidence: The label for this category is "ТЕЦ" (Cyrillic), not "TELЦ". This is an incorrect transliteration.
The color of the "АЕЦ" sector is orange, not brown ("кафяво").

errors.text_span: а всички сектори са с подобен тон
errors.evidence: The colors are distinct and varied (blue, orange, green, purple, light blue, red) and not of a 'similar tone'.
The description lists the sectors as if sorted by value, but this part of the sequence is incorrectly ordered (16% is followed by 2%, then 5%). The correct descending order would be 16%, 5%, 2%.

errors.text_span: Секторите, организирани в кръга, изглеждат подредени по намаляващ размер, започвайки от "TELЦ".
errors.evidence: The sectors are not visually arranged in descending order of size. The largest sector (40%) is followed clockwise by one of the smallest sectors (2%).
